skills.name: Basic Attack: Penetrating Shock
skills.desc:
Press  to activate:
Perform up to five slashes ahead, dealing Electric DMG. After the 4th attack hits the enemy, repeatedly press or hold  to quickly pass through enemies in front up to 5 times.

skills.name: Dodge: Strobe
skills.desc:
Press  to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Dash Attack: Torrent
skills.desc:
Press  during a dodge to activate:
Perform a horizontal slash forward, then follow up with a thrust attack, dealing Electric DMG.

skills.name: Dodge Counter: Ground Flash Counter
skills.desc:
Press  during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Repeatedly slash enemies in front, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Quick Assist: Cloud Flash
skills.desc:
Assist
Quick Assist
When the active character is launched, press  to activate:
Repeatedly slash enemies in front, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Defensive Assist: Counter Surge
skills.desc:
Assist
Defensive Assist
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press  to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Assist Follow-Up: Conducting Blow
skills.desc:
Assist
Assist Follow-Up
Press  after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Dash forward and unleash a series of slashes at enemies ahead, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Special Attack: Celestial Thunder
skills.desc:
Press  to activate:
Dash diagonally forward, then unleash a cross slash, dealing Electric DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: Special Attack: Azure Flash
skills.desc:
When Soldier 0 - Anby's attacks hit an enemy, they apply the Silver Star mark and charges the target
For every one-third of charge, the enemy receives 1 stack of White Thunder, stacking up to 3 times.
When the enemy has White Thunder, press  to activate:
Quickly dash forward, slashing through enemies and dealing multiple hits of Electric DMG.
When the skill hits an enemy, it will consume 1 stack of White Thunder to trigger an Aftershock that deals 1 extra instance of Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Special Attack: Thunder Smite
skills.desc:
When the additional damage from White Thunder triggers 3 times on the same enemy:
A lightning strike will fall at the enemy's location, dealing Electric DMG to enemies within range.
This DMG is considered Aftershock DMG.

skills.name: EX Special Attack: Sundering Bolt
skills.desc:
With enough energy, hold  to activate:
Combines her twin swords and throws them forward for a high-speed slash, dealing massive Electric DMG.
When the skill hits an enemy, it will fully charge Silver Star.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Chain Attack: Leaping Thunderstrike
skills.desc:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Leap forward, then quickly dive and perform a cross slash, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Ultimate: Voidstrike
skills.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press  to activate:
Perform a powerful series of slashes at a large area in front, followed by a lightning strike, dealing massive Electric DMG.
When the skill hits an enemy, it will fully charge Silver Star.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Core Passive: Voltage Gap
skills.desc: Soldier 0 - Anby's DMG against enemies with the Silver Star mark increases by X%. After an enemy is marked with Silver Star, the CRIT DMG received from Aftershock attacks is further increased by 30% of Soldier 0 - Anby's CRIT DMG.

skills.name: Additional Ability: Voltage Surge
skills.desc:
When another character in your squad is a Stun or Support character:
Soldier 0 - Anby's CRIT Rate increases by 10%. When Soldier 0 - Anby is the active character, all squad members' Aftershock DMG to enemies with a Silver Star mark increases by 25%.

cons.name: Static Charge
cons.desc: When Soldier 0 - Anby uses an EX Special Attack to hit an enemy, it triggers the additional DMG from White Thunder 3 times. This effect does not consume any White Thunder stacks.

cons.name: Fail-Safe Protocol
cons.desc:
Soldier 0 - Anby's CRIT Rate increases by 12%.
When she uses her Ultimate, she gains 6 stacks of Thunder's Cry (max 6 stacks).
With Thunder's Cry, when using Special Attack: Azure Flash to hit an enemy with White Thunder, it will consume 1 stack of Thunder's Cry instead.
Only 1 stack of Thunder's Cry will be consumed when a single use of a skill hits multiple enemies, and consuming Thunder's Cry will still activate the additional DMG from White Thunder.

cons.name: Past Glory
cons.desc: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cons.name: Silver Reverb
cons.desc: When hitting an enemy marked with Silver Star, Soldier 0 - Anby ignores 12% of the target's Electric RES.

cons.name: Director's Cut
cons.desc: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cons.name: Prequel Protagonist
cons.desc: Upon triggering 6 instances of White Thunder's additional DMG, an electromagnetic vortex will be generated, dealing 1,000% of Soldier 0 - Anby's ATK as Electric DMG against the target and surrounding enemies. This DMG is considered Aftershock DMG.
